name: Behavior
description: The scenarios a project declares, and where each one sits.

scenarios.title: What the directory declares, and where
given: a behavior directory holding more than one specification
scenarios.then: every scenario answers with the line of the file that declares it

scenarios.title: A directory nobody wrote
given: a behavior directory that is not there

scenarios.title: The root arrives absolute
given: a behavior directory named by an absolute path
scenarios.when: a message about one of its scenarios is composed
scenarios.then: the path answers relative to where the run started

scenarios.title: One id under two scenarios
given: two specifications declaring the same id
scenarios.then: both places the id was declared are named

scenarios.title: A scenario with no id
given: a specification declaring a scenario without an id
scenarios.then: the file is named as declaring a scenario nothing can reference

scenarios.title: A specification that will not parse
given: a behavior specification that is not readable JSON
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable

scenarios.title: Several ids on one marker line
given: the text a marker line carries after its keyword, naming more than one id
scenarios.then: each id is answered on its own

scenarios.title: Two scenarios on one line
given: a specification declaring two scenarios on the same line
scenarios.then: both answer at that line rather than the second answering at none
